plan.rationale: Dispatching two drones to high-risk, densely occupied blocks with up to 65% collapse probability that the helicopter could not assess or has not reached. D1 will survey the One Sansome Street URM-infill block (~9,019 occupants), while D2 will inspect the 32 Battery St URM-infill block (~1,162 occupants) where AIR 1 had no visibility. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up on newly discovered collapses.

plan.rationale: With AIR 1's scan complete and no further drone waves remaining, we are deploying all three drones to maximize life-saving reconnaissance. D1 will verify trapped survivors and fire spread across damaged buildings along California and Pine Streets, D2 will survey unscanned high-occupancy blocks at Rincon Annex and the PG&E and Park Tower blocks in SoMa, and D3 will check trapped signs at 447 Battery St and the unscanned 600 Battery St URM block while resolving the model disagreement at One Maritime Plaza.
